findings.summary: The Esparza-Lamb engagement's client design meetings and progress reports are conducted entirely by Design Technicians with no engineer present, unlike every later engagement, which is implausible for a firm whose drawings only leave under the Principal Engineer's seal.
findings.evidence: The design-coordination and pre-issue meetings (d:0009, d:0012) both list attendees as only 'Linda Nguyen, Design Technician / Jason Jordan, Design Technician / Debra Vasquez, Vice President of Finance' and resolve design questions there ('it was agreed that the supplemental shot would be requested'); the client progress report d:0013 is signed solely by 'Linda Nguyen, Design Technician' and commits the fee. By contrast the Johnson (d:0022), Evans-Lee (d:0028), Franklin-Snyder (d:0033), and Peck-Jennings (d:0038) progress meetings each have a Project Engineer (Warren or George) present and leading.
